parts.t: Aberdeen is in the southwest corner of Abbotsford, next to the Langley border. It is mostly farmland and includes the Pepin Brook community, Aldergrove Regional Park and the Fraser Highway. The area takes its name from Aberdeen school, named after its Scottish settlers.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 12, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Abbotsford and the Agricultural Land Commission.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Before you buy or sell, check the zoning, what the community plan says, and which schools serve the address.
